icon.title: Tray icon
icon.desc: Trend shows the latest CPU samples as columns, Share lights a grid of dots for the current usage, and Number shows the percentage. All turn amber from 80%.

card.title: Hover card
card.desc: Shows live CPU, memory, GPU and network readings while the pointer rests on the tray icon. When off, the system tooltip shows instead.

menu.title: Right-clicking the tray icon
menu.desc: The quick panel shows live readings, the busiest processes and common actions; the menu lists the common actions only.

moved.title: Tray and components
moved.desc: The tray icon, the quick panel, what closing the window does and the refresh rate in the tray.

metrics.title: Readings shown
metrics.desc: Drag a category or a reading to change the order. With more than one GPU, disk or network adapter, readings can be chosen for each device.

desktop.title: Desktop monitor
desktop.desc: Shows the chosen readings in a small window on the desktop. Double-click it to open Argus, or right-click it to open the menu.

layout.title: Layout
layout.desc: A panel stacks the device groups vertically; a strip lines them up horizontally and wraps between groups when space runs out.

grouping.title: Grouping
grouping.desc: How the List and Curves styles set each device’s readings apart.

clickThrough.title: Click-through
clickThrough.desc: Clicks and drags go to the window underneath. Once on, it can be turned off only on this page.

taskbar.title: Taskbar monitor
taskbar.desc: Shows the chosen readings on the taskbar. A click shows or hides the window; a right-click opens a panel to change the style and the readings shown.

place.title: Position
place.desc: “Left side” applies only to the Windows 11 taskbar with centered buttons. Otherwise the monitor appears next to the tray.

display.title: Display
display.desc: While the chosen display is disconnected or shows no taskbar, the monitor appears on the main display.

style.title: Style
style.desc: Curves, capsules and large figures need room for two rows of text; on a lower taskbar they show as labels.

lookout.title: Crow’s nest
lookout.desc: Live readings and notifications in a capsule at the top of the screen.

card.click: Click: show or hide the window
